questions.q: The function \( f(x) = \frac{3x + 1}{x - 2} \) is defined for \( x \ne 2 \). Find the inverse function \( f^{-1}(x) \).
questions.answer: Let \( y = \frac{3x + 1}{x - 2} \implies y(x - 2) = 3x + 1 \implies yx - 2y = 3x + 1 \implies x(y - 3) = 2y + 1 \implies x = \frac{2y + 1}{y - 3} \). Swap variables to obtain \( f^{-1}(x) = \frac{2x + 1}{x - 3} \). [M1][A1]
